prompt_en: A hurried photorealistic night photograph catches an unmistakably adult nekomimi witch, a human woman with two distinct triangular cat ears rising through her windblown hair, flying on a rough wooden broom beneath dim moonlight. She sits securely at the broom center, wearing a closed practical riding coat over plain trousers; her left hand braces on the forward handle while her torso twists over her right shoulder. With her free right hand she aims a short wand behind her and fires a sharp luminous projectile toward the pursuing KF-21 fighter jet. The aircraft is visibly closing from behind along the same flight path, its recognizable swept wings and twin tails cutting through broken low clouds; the glowing shot crosses the space between witch and jet. The broom bristles stream aft with her movement. Viewed from an oblique ground-level vantage, both figures remain in one unsettled frame with a slightly tilted horizon, imperfect edge crop, coarse high-ISO grain, and restrained motion streaks. Moonlit clouds and a faint rim on the ears and broom keep the scene dark while the return shot briefly illuminates her tense face. The witch and jet occupy opposite ends of a falling diagonal, with her bright return shot bridging the gap. A long lens compresses their distance while leaving a fine smear of cloud at the near edge.
